ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms a decision, alternatives and consequences are written; it does not show the decision is sound or still current.
offer: Record the chosen approach, credible alternatives and concrete consequences. A decision record should explain the tradeoff that shaped the system rather than restating the implementation.

minimal.reason: State the chosen approach in one decision. A record that restates the implementation explains nothing, so say what was chosen and why.

mid.reason: List the credible alternatives that were rejected. Without them the tradeoff is invisible, so name each option and why it lost.

maximal.reason: Record the concrete consequences of the decision, good and bad. Omitting them hides the cost the next maintainer inherits, so list what changes.
